Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original raster KEY-POSE BOARD for director review of a 2D chibi wuxia pixel-art game, NOT a final animation or gameplay screenshot. Reference image 1 is approved Shaolin CHARACTER IDENTITY ONLY: bald young monk, golden saffron layered tunic, dark brown prayer beads and trousers, cream forearm/ankle wraps, brown shoes, determined brows. Reference image 2 is existing gameplay-scale sprite/style only. Do not modify either reference.
Create exactly 16 separate original pixel-art key poses on a transparent canvas, a perfectly regular 4 columns by 4 rows layout. Four columns in EVERY ROW are: (1) braced anticipation, (2) raised leg, heel lifted very high ready for a downward axe-kick/stomp, (3) forceful FOOT SLAM contact, heel planted on ground, body follows downward, (4) recovery to guard. Four rows in order: facing RIGHT (profile toward right), facing DOWN (face/front), facing LEFT (profile toward left), facing UP (back of bald head/back of tunic). All four poses in a row face the SAME specified direction. The up/back row must really show the back; front/down must show face. The planted support foot stays fixed through all four poses, no forward dash or travel. At contact the stamping heel is down, not raised. Clear large changes in leg articulation. Arms guard/balance, empty hands, NO weapon, NO staff, NO sword, NO kicking a projectile from the air. No earth/dust/energy painted into the body board. Do not draw both alternate left and right sweeping kicks; this is one strong stomp.
Match a Pokemon-like elevated 3/4 orthographic overhead RPG view, not isometric, no perspective camera change. Oversized expressive head, short compact athletic body, readable robe folds, dark outlines, warm upper-left light, carefully clustered limited pixel palette, crisp pixel edges. Keep each monk around 170 pixels tall inside an approximately 256x256 transparent cell so the eventual normalized 44px gameplay body can be evaluated; a little extra height for the raised foot is okay but head/costume size must be consistent across cells. Large fully transparent gaps between silhouettes and borders. No text, labels, frames, shadows, scenery, grid, watermark, checkerboard or background. This is a contact/key-pose concept, do not invent in-between frames. All 16 poses fully visible, no cropping.

records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-art VFX KEY-POSE BOARD for an elevated 3/4 top-down orthographic wuxia RPG. Original Shaolin EARTH MOUND attack, warm brown soil, gray-brown fractured stones, a few small golden impact sparks, no character, no text or UI, no copied DOTA art.
Transparent canvas with EXACTLY 5 columns and 4 rows, 20 well-separated individual silhouettes, equal-size transparent cells and generous margins. Row 1 travels RIGHT, row 2 travels DOWN toward viewer, row 3 travels LEFT, row 4 travels UP away from viewer. Columns in EVERY row: 1 BIRTH low ground bulge forming upward; 2 TRAVEL A a compact single mound/crest of soil and stone surging forward; 3 TRAVEL B same mound crest with changed small rocks/dust, same footprint; 4 TARGET IMPACT a short localized rocky impact burst at target feet; 5 OUTRO broken soil settling, low dust and scattered small stones fading. Each mound is an independent effect shown AT ITS LOCAL ORIGIN. NO baked long path across the cell. Direction must read from a forward crest and short trailing dust: RIGHT row forward crest on right/dust tail left; DOWN row forward crest at bottom/dust recedes up; LEFT opposite; UP crest at top/dust tail toward bottom. Rocks remain upright under the fixed camera, do not rotate the ground plane. Show one moving mound, not a field of spikes or a tall stalagmite forest. Broad rocky rolling ridge, about twice as wide as tall, physically readable silhouettes, keep effects small enough not to hide an entire hero. Target gameplay mound dimensions roughly 48x28 pixels after reduction, here drawn enlarged in about 180x110 area per transparent cell. No glowing magic rings, no fire, no lava, no vines, no long beam, no ground backdrop or tile image, no permanent crack trail. Body and stun indicator will be separate assets.
Style: deliberately clustered crisp pixel-art edges, dark earthy outlines, controlled gold/brown palette with stone facets and a few readable dust clumps, upper-left highlights, common Pokemon-like 3/4 RPG perspective, not isometric diamond grid, not side-view. Canvas alpha really transparent; no checkerboard, shadows, labels, watermark or frames. This is a key-pose concept for review, not a claim of completed in-between animation.
